source.notes: Scanned school paper (no text layer apart from the icseboard.org watermark); the scan is faint in places. Printed header: GRADE VIII, TIME - 2 HOURS, ASSESSMENT II, BIOLOGY, M.M. 80. No year is printed on the paper; examYear 2025 is taken from the file name (…-280425-2025.pdf). Section A (40 Marks, attempt all) is groups I-VII, each with one printed mark for the whole group (I [10], II-VII [5] each), so each group is one entry; a stray '[5]' printed beside the last option line of group I at the top of page 2 is not counted (group I prints [10]). Section B (40 Marks) says 'Attempt any four questions from this sections' and has six questions (10 marks each), so the pack total (100) exceeds the 80-mark maximum; no choiceGroup is set. The Section B question labels (VIII-XIII) are partly covered by handwritten marks on the scan and were read in sequence. PDF page 4 is NOT part of this Biology paper: it is a page from a Computer paper (fill in the blanks on title bar/LAN/Java, true or false, network topologies) and was excluded. Handwritten scores and ticks on the scan were ignored. No school name printed. No answer key.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.

questions.text: Choose the correct option. 1. Which one of the following hormones stimulates the breakdown of glycogen in the liver into glucose? a) Insulin b) Adrenaline c) Glucagon d) Thyroxine 2. The vein which brings oxygenated blood to the heart from the lungs: a) Renal Vein b) Superior Vena cava c) Pulmonary Vein d) Coronary Vein 3. The smell of good food causes watering of your mouth. It is : a) Natural reflex b) Acquired reflex c) Inborn reflex d) Ordinary reflex 4. Dengue is caused by a) Protozoan b) Virus c) Worm d) Fungus 5. Medulla oblongata controls: a) Smelling b) Beating of heart and respiratory movement c) Intelligence and Will power d) Balancing of the body 6. The idea of vaccination was conceived by a) Charles Darwin b) Alexander Flemming c) Issac Newton d) Edward Jenner 7. Which of the following is the common breed of buffalo found in Gujrat? a) Surti b) Murrah c) Gir d) Mehsana 8. The emergency hormone to face the danger or to fight is secreted by: a) Islets of langerhans b) Adrenal Cortex c) Pituitary d) Adrenal medulla 9. Among the following, a kharif crop is: a) Barley b) Mustard c) Wheat d) Rice 10. Which of the following hormone converts excess of glucose into glycogen? a) Glucagon b) Thyroxine c) Insulin d) Adrenaline
